subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: The direct inbound parser gap is source-reproducible, but exposing full card, button, form, and selector data while preserving existing command-button behavior is a channel behavior/API choice.

options.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let callback-field plus merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Reduce to direct inbound
options.body: Treat this issue as only top-level `interactive` message parsing and leave card-action callbacks plus merge_forward entirely to existing linked items.

options.title: Defer full payloads
options.body: Pause broad parsing until maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card/form payloads beyond current text extraction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let callback-field plus merge_forward issues own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained contact for the affected plugin and payload contract.
